blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) recorded revenue collections of P757.406 billion from January to September 2026, exceeding its target for the year. According to the BOC on Sunday, it surpassed its target of P748.494 billion for the year, noting that it is “ahead of its collection program with three months remaining in the year.” READ: BOC missed August collection target Aside from this, the agency said it accumulated P55.735 billion more than in the same period last year, equivalent to a 7.9% increase. “The growth underscores that the Bureau’s revenue performance is not based on projections alone, but […]...
